whenToUse: Square media for list rows, feature cards and empty states, held to one size and radius
Status and brand markers in a soft tint, a solid fill or a theme or Tailwind palette color
Compact links, initials or counts, and glyphs with a status dot pinned to one corner

whenNotToUse.when: A finished first run screen with heading, message and actions around the glyph
A finished KPI or feature tile with a value, a label and a trend beside the glyph
Markers for each step of a multi step flow, with active and completed states
